description: Propose changed terms on the same project, including license MIT. Every maker must explicitly accept the changed agreement_hash before publication. When enabled, new agreements require one 0.01 USDC first approved purchase. Use first_purchase_promotion=true to migrate an older agreement. Earlier versions and purchases retain their licenses and terms; an amendment never revokes MIT rights already granted.

first_purchase_promotion.description: When enabled, one first approved purchase for 0.01 USDC is a required publication term. Omit or use true; false is rejected. Existing makers must accept an amendment before republishing.

license.description: Change the existing project agreement to MIT or commercial-use-no-redistribution-v1. Every maker, including the publisher, must accept the new hash. Existing versions and purchases keep their original licenses.

name: speedbot_product_amend
title: Product amend
